aggressive_definition: Advanced incident prostate cancer; the abstract also analyzes nonadvanced and total prostate cancer.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: After adjustment for confounders, dietary intakes of phylloquinone, menaquinones, and total vitamin K, assessed with either the DQX or DHQ, were not significantly associated with the risk of advanced, nonadvanced, and total prostate cancer.
study_design: Prospective observational cohort analysis within the PLCO Screening Trial using baseline and third-anniversary dietary questionnaires.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: During a median follow-up of 11.8 y, 2978 cases of prostate cancer (including 490 advanced cases) were identified from the 28,356 men who completed DQX. Similarly, 2973 cases of prostate cancer (including 647 advanced cases) were documented from the 48,090 men who completed DHQ.
reason: The abstract prospectively analyzes both total and advanced incident prostate cancer. It reports two overlapping questionnaire-based analytic samples with different case counts, so no single cohort N, general case count, or aggressive case count represents the entire study.
